Method of Attack: Information-stealing Trojan that steals saved credentials in web browsers, desktop messaging clients (Pidgin, Steam, Discord), FTP clients, cryptocurrency wallets, documents, and takes screenshots of active applications; Distributed via fake advertisements impersonating legitimate applications (Microsoft Store, Spotify, online document converter); Automatic download of malicious zip file from Amazon AWS server upon visiting fake landing pages; Execution of malware upon unzipping and launching the executable
Attack Vector: Malicious advertising campaigns promoting fake applications
Fake landing pages impersonating Microsoft Store, Spotify, and online document converter
Automatic download of malware from Amazon AWS servers
Indicators of Compromise: Fake Microsoft Store page for 'xChess 3' online chess application
Any.Run report and VirusTotal analysis of the zip file
Fake Spotify and online document converter landing pages
